g.text: POST /ai/transcribe with the audio and its length
Check the allowance, the audio type and the size
[longer than 5 minutes, or over the byte cap]
Text and, when reported, its duration
Seconds = the provider's duration, else the larger of the
client's figure and a floor derived from the bytes, capped at 300
Bill 200 tokens per started minute, one minute at least
The transcript in the composer, editable
[the key can speak, and the writer has not muted]
Check 20 a minute and 300 a day for this account
Dictation costs tokens; listening does not. Reading aloud is rate-limited
per account instead, and the mute control exists only when
GET /ai/speech-availability says the key can speak. The mute choice
